acceptance.statement: Raw interaction/feedback/note/journal/insight events persist in Postgres-backed durable inbox surviving stack restart
Default worker processes inbox to generate versioned dataset records and Observe/Learn evidence handoffs
Evidence handoffs are strictly limited to Observe/Learn and cannot promote, deploy, or trade
Worker and inbox processing are idempotent by evidence_id
Backlog and DLQ are exposed, and failed items are replayable back to pending status

proof: PostgresAgoraDatasetStore connects to Postgres DB via psycopg using tables: agora_evidence_inbox, agora_dataset_records, agora_evidence_handoffs.
Tables are bootstrapped automatically with constraints and indexes surviving restarts.
AgoraDatasetStore.process_inbox worker queries pending entries in transaction block.
Generates versioned dataset records and groups them into Observe/Learn handoffs.
add_to_inbox uses INSERT OR SELECT to detect duplicates idempotently.
Subsequent requests retrieve existing records with idempotent=true flag.
get_backlog, get_dlq, and replay_dlq_item methods manage the inbox states.

PR #3675 (task/LOOP-PROD-AGORA-001, commit fb3190f0b) fixes the round-1 change request: Postgres add_to_inbox (extractor.py:184-260) now does SELECT, then INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (evidence_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING created_at, then re-SELECTs on conflict, closing the SELECT-then-INSERT TOCTOU race that previously raised an unhandled IntegrityError under concurrent duplicate submission.

New test test_concurrent_add_to_inbox_postgres (services/control-plane/bff/agora/dataset_extraction/test_extractor.py) fires 10 concurrent threads submitting the same evidence_id against a real Postgres backend; independently re-run in this review against the live pantheon-postgres-1 container (TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:15432/postgres pytest ... -k postgres) -> 2 passed (test_backlog_worker_and_handoff_lifecycle_postgres, test_concurrent_add_to_inbox_postgres), confirming exactly 1 is_new=True and 9 is_new=False.

process_inbox per-row work is now wrapped in conn.transaction() savepoints so one row's processing failure no longer aborts the shared connection transaction and blocks the failure-status UPDATE or other rows' commits in the same batch.

scripts/agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py seed/verify now also seeds an evidence row, asserts it is in the backlog, runs process_inbox, and asserts it lands in agora_dataset_records after a container restart; wired into .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml alongside the existing workshop/governance postgres-backend and initialized-log checks. Independently re-run end-to-end against the live pantheon-postgres-1 container in this review (schema agora_smoke_test): `seed` then `verify` both exited 0, verify reporting `completed_outbox=replayed recovery_outbox=recovered` with the evidence row round-tripping through backlog -> process_inbox -> agora_dataset_records.
